英語文 · 國二上學期 · 章節筆記

過去進行式、時間連接詞與數量詞

The past continuous tense (was/were + V-ing) describes an action that was in progress at a specific moment in the past. When combined with "when" or "while", it shows an ongoing background action interrupted by another past action. Countable and uncountable nouns use distinct quantifiers (many/few vs much/little).

章節重點

過去進行式
主詞 + was/were + V-ingAt 8 p.m. yesterday, I was studying.；主詞單複數決定 was/were
when 與 while
when 接瞬間過去動作；while 接持續進行動作I was taking a shower when the phone rang. / While Dad was cooking, Mom was reading.
可數與不可數數量
many/a few/few 接可數複數；much/a little/little 接不可數many friends, much water；a few（正面）vs few（負面）

示範與推理

完成「While Leo ___ (cook), the phone ___ (ring). There was ___ rice left, so he made only a small meal.」第三格選 a little 或 a few。

  1. 背景動作是當時正在煮飯，填 was cooking；電話響是一次發生的事件，填 rang。
  2. rice 在此不可數，使用 a little rice；a few 要修飾複數可數名詞，如 a few eggs。
  3. 完整句為 While Leo was cooking, the phone rang. There was a little rice left, so he made only a small meal.。

易錯提醒　Do not confuse "a few" (positive: some) with "few" (negative: almost none), or "a little" (some) with "little" (almost none). Remember "were" is used for you/we/they in past continuous.

闔上筆記，試著回想

  1. When the earthquake struck, we ___ dinner in the dining room.
    • A．have
    • B．ate
    • C．were having
    • D．are having
  2. Describe what you and your family members were doing yesterday at 7 p.m. using past continuous and "while".
參考解答與自評

第 1 題　C（were having）。The ongoing background activity during a past event requires past continuous: "were having".

第 2 題　用上方的章節重點自評。寫出答案，標明依據，並核對所用條件、單位或情境是否適合。
